prompt: I've got a slow-speed rotary indexing table driven by a small motor and I need a big reduction ratio in one stage, so I need the driven part of that pair. It has to mesh with a small mating driver on a parallel axis, transmit maybe a couple of Nm smoothly and quietly with minimal backlash, and mount onto a 12 mm ground shaft with enough material around the shaft that I can drill and tap for a set screw without it flexing. It sits in a shallow housing so it can't be very thick overall. Can you design that for me?

judge.notes: Only the use case was described. Grade whether the design would serve that use; any geometry that works is correct.
